title: Immediate implant grafted with xenograft and hyaluronate verses xenograft and injectable platelet rich fibrin comparative study clinically and radiografically. Khairy B.S., Al-Naqeeb A.J. Endodontics Today
supports: Clinical study from the botiss cerabone plus (bovine bone with hyaluronate) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Both grafting materials effectively preserved the ridge dimensions and supported implant stability, but xenograft combined with HA showed a modest advantage in maintaining the buccal bone crest” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
